title: NetworkFeatures
description: Network connection telemetry, beaconing metrics, and socket forensics schema for the Network modality (Track B). Scored by LightGBM.

active_connection_count.description: Total active TCP/UDP sockets in ESTABLISHED or SYN states

outbound_connection_count.description: Active connections targeting external/non-loopback remote IPs

dns_query_count.description: Total DNS requests observed during the execution capture window
dns_query_count.source: tshark pcap DNS filter / pyshark live parser

unique_remote_ips.description: Cardinality of distinct destination IP addresses contacted
unique_remote_ips.source: tshark pcap IP analysis / live flow table

avg_interpacket_interval_ms.description: Mean time delta between consecutive outbound packets targeting primary C2 endpoint

beacon_regularity_score.description: Standardized periodic beaconing score (1.0 = highly deterministic interval, indicating automated C2 beacon; 0.0 = high jitter/aperiodic)
beacon_regularity_score.source: Derived from inter-packet arrival time variance

total_bytes_sent.description: Cumulative payload and transport bytes transmitted outbound

total_bytes_received.description: Cumulative bytes received inbound across the network interface

suspicious_port_usage.description: Binary flag indicating connections over common reverse shell / C2 ports (e.g., 4444, 1337, 8080, 8443, 6667)
